subject: Exec roundtable: build velocity & release contingencies
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Torres <e.torres@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec roundtable: build velocity & release contingencies

Team —

We have the QBR steering meeting on 2026-11-02; I want to run a short exec roundtable next week to align on delivery health and the contingency plan for the upcoming release window. High level asks: 

- One-paragraph status for the product/engineering roadmap (what's green/at-risk/blocking).
- Top 3 delivery risks (impact + probability) and proposed mitigations.
- Any adjustments to launch date assumptions or scope you recommend.

Please reply inline with your updates and attach any supporting artifacts (timeline, risk matrix). If possible, send by EOD Thu 10/22 so I can synthesize for leadership. 

QBR context: Atlas Health will be evaluating the rollout cadence for their dedicated workloads; we should be explicit about latency/cost trade-offs and ramp plan. Emily — adding you for visibility; feel free to flag anything you want us to highlight.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[attachment: qbr-context.pdf (summary)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Emily Torres <e.torres@atlashealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec roundtable: build velocity & release contingencies

On Tue, Oct 20, 2026 at 9:12 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
>
> We have the QBR steering meeting on 2026-11-02; I want to run a short exec roundtable next week to align on delivery health and the contingency plan for the upcoming release window.

Quick update from Product/Engineering (short bullets as requested):

- Overall roadmap status: core model-serving work and SDK changes are on track for the feature freeze on 10/29. Non-blocking items (observability UX tweaks) are being deprioritized to protect the critical path.
- Velocity: last three sprints delivered ~82% of committed stories (headcount and infra churn are the main drivers).
- Top risks: 
  1) Quantized-model perf variance on NVidia A100L — probability: medium, impact: high. Mitigation: fallback to mixed-precision binary in the canary region and extended perf runs this week.
  2) Cross-service integration tests intermittently failing under long-tail traffic shapes — probability: high, impact: medium. Mitigation: dedicate an SRE rotation to reproduce failures; postpone non-essential non-runtime merges to stabilize test harness.
  3) Release gating: delayed artifact signing due to new security checklist — probability: low, impact: high for orgs needing compliance. Mitigation: parallelize signing steps with the release ops team.

Attaching the timeline I used for planning: release-timeline-v2.pdf.

Will follow up with a short section for the QBR slide deck (owner + ask).

—Vivek
VP, Engineering
[attachment: release-timeline-v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, DataGrid Solutions <procure@datagrid.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec roundtable: build velocity & release contingencies

On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 10:05 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick update from Product/Engineering (short bullets as requested):
>
Thanks — ops view below.

- Infra capacity: we have the reserved pool for the 11/02 window but observed a 12% utilization spike during load tests yesterday (long-tail requests). We can absorb with short-term autoscale but it increases per-token cost ~9% if sustained.
- Incident note: on 10/19 we had an upstream networking flap in eu-west which briefly increased latency for canary traffic; remediation steps are documented and applied.
- Procurement dependency: two GPU nodes from DataGrid are delayed by one week. Procurement is engaged (cc'd). Risk: if nodes arrive late we will have to shift a canary to a different rack (minor latency delta).

Mitigation actions planned:
- SRE will run an extended perf sweep across the quantized and mixed-precision configs (owner: Sean).
- Ops will hold a cutover dry run on 10/28 to validate fallback routing and autoscale thresholds (owner: Irene).
- If DataGrid misses delivery we will short-run a capacity plan that reduces canary size by 30% and increase sampling for latency gating.

Attaching the risk matrix I populated: qbr-risk-matrix.xlsx

—Sean
Director, Reliability Engineering
[attachment: qbr-risk-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Torres <e.torres@atlashealth.com>, DataGrid Solutions <procure@datagrid.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:00:00 -0700

Thank you — this is exactly what I needed. I pulled the updates into a one-page brief for the execs and drafted a 30-minute agenda for the roundtable:

Agenda (30m) — 11/01, 11:00-11:30 PT\- 5m: Current roadmap health (Vivek)\- 10m: Key risks + mitigations (Sean + SRE owner)\- 10m: Customer impact & comms (Monica / Neha)

Decisions we need at the roundtable:
- Approve small-scope rollback criteria for the canary (thresholds: 95th p50 latency + error rate).
- Confirm the backup plan if DataGrid delivery slips (reduce canary to 70% capacity).
- Agree on messaging to Atlas Health about potential latency variance and cost trade-off.

Action items before the exec roundtable (owners):
- Sean: perf sweep report by 10/27 EOD (attachment to final brief).
- Vivek: confirm which non-essential merges to hold and update slide (10/27 EOD).
- Neha: draft customer messaging for Atlas Health (10/27 noon).

Emily — if you want a short talking point or ask added to the agenda, send it over and I will slot it.

Irene — can you confirm the dry run timing on 10/28?

Thanks all — will circulate the final brief on 10/27 after I receive the inputs.

—Monica
